facts.text: I attended a seminar on productivity a couple of weeks before I asked for help brainstorming ways to stay on track.
I wake up at 7:00 AM.
Since the daylight saving time change last month, I have trouble getting out of bed before 7:30 AM.
I usually get to work by 8:30 AM.
My top priorities are responding to urgent emails and tackling the most important tasks for the day.
I have a team meeting on Fridays at 2:00 PM.
I feel stuck around 3:00 PM when I start to feel sluggish and my energy levels drop.
I want to make time for meditation and exercise, but it is hard to fit them in.
I like dividing my workday into focused 90-minute blocks.
I schedule my most important tasks for the morning when I am most focused.
I have been trying to reduce my coffee intake.
I want alternative energy boosters that do not cause a crash later on.
I want healthy snack options to keep my energy levels up throughout the day.
I plan to try nuts and seeds as snack options.
I plan to try fresh fruits as snack options.
I plan to try protein-rich snack balls as snack options.
I want to start incorporating more meditation and exercise into my daily routine.
I think I need to make a plan and stick to it.
I will schedule my meditation and exercise sessions into my daily planner.
I will set aside time for healthy snacks.
I will start small and focus on making one or two changes at a time.
I will celebrate my small wins along the way.
I am going to use a habit tracker to monitor my progress and stay on track.
I have heard that seeing your successes can be a great motivator.
I want recommendations for habit trackers or apps to help me stay organized.
